headline: 816 children dead in measles outbreak as 6 more die in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a surge in measles-related deaths, with 691 new infections reported in a single day.
details: Six more children have died within 24 hours due to measles symptoms, according to a regular report from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) released on Saturday.
Since March 15, a total of 816 children have died nationwide. This includes 721 deaths attributed to measles symptoms and 95 confirmed cases of measles.
The health department's latest data shows that 691 children were newly infected with measles or showed symptoms of the disease in the last 24 hours.
While six children died from symptoms, the DGHS report specified that no deaths occurred from confirmed measles cases during this specific 24-hour window.

headline: 3 killed as bus crashes into two motorcycles in Dhamrai
summary: The victims were riding motorcycles on the Dhaka-Aricha highway when a speeding bus failed to stop and hit them from behind.
details: Three people were killed after a bus crashed into two motorcycles on the Dhaka-Aricha highway in Dhaka's Dhamrai upazila this morning.
The deceased were identified as Abas Saha, 25, Syed Naimul Haque, 30, and Sujoy Saha, 18.
According to police, the accident occurred around 7:30am in the Islampur area of Dhamrai when a bus had broken down and was stranded in a lane of the highway.
A speeding private car and a covered van managed to stop behind the stalled bus, prompting two motorcycles to slow down as well.
However, a bus travelling behind them failed to stop and crashed into the motorcycles, dragging them several metres.
Abas and Sujoy, who were riding one of the motorcycles, suffered critical injuries and were declared dead at Dhamrai Upazila Health Complex.
The other motorcyclist, Syed Naimul Haque, was taken to Enam Medical College Hospital in Savar, where he died in the ICU around 12:30pm.
Authorities have removed the vehicles involved in the accident from the highway.
caption:
A morning commute turns fatal as a bus crashes into two motorcycles in Dhamrai, killing three.

Three people were killed after a bus crashed into two motorcycles on the Dhaka-Aricha highway in Dhaka's Dhamrai upazila this morning.

The deceased were identified as Abas Saha, 25, Syed Naimul Haque, 30, and Sujoy Saha, 18.

According to police, the accident occurred around 7:30am in the Islampur area of Dhamrai when a bus had broken down and was stranded in a lane of the highway.

A speeding private car and a covered van managed to stop behind the stalled bus, prompting two motorcycles to slow down as well.

However, a bus travelling behind them failed to stop and crashed into the motorcycles, dragging them several metres.

Abas and Sujoy, who were riding one of the motorcycles, suffered critical injuries and were declared dead at Dhamrai Upazila Health Complex.

The other motorcyclist, Syed Naimul Haque, was taken to Enam Medical College Hospital in Savar, where he died in the ICU around 12:30pm.

Authorities have removed the vehicles involved in the accident from the highway.
